fusions.name: Running Flame
fusions.desc: Fire runs out along your chains, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: White-Hot Brand
fusions.desc: Presses a heated link into the target for 18 damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage each, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Searing Coil
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kindling Leap
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a heated link flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, then leaps to 3 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
